items.question: Trong câu "In 45–60 minutes the interviewer watches how you reason: do you clarify an ambiguous problem, size it with numbers, choose components for stated reasons, find the bottleneck and name the trade-off you accepted?", từ "clarify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In 45–60 minutes the interviewer watches how you reason: do you clarify an ambiguous problem, size it with numbers, choose components for stated reasons, find the bottleneck and name the trade-off you accepted?", what does "clarify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: clarify /ˈklærəfaɪ/ (động từ): làm rõ. "Clarify the requirements" = làm rõ yêu cầu; nên hỏi để làm rõ trước khi thiết kế.
items.explanationEn: clarify /ˈklærəfaɪ/ (verb): to make clear. "Clarify the requirements" is a common collocation; ask questions to make things clear before designing.

items.question: Trong câu "In 45–60 minutes the interviewer watches how you reason: do you clarify an ambiguous problem, size it with numbers, choose components for stated reasons, find the bottleneck and name the trade-off you accepted?", từ "ambiguous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In 45–60 minutes the interviewer watches how you reason: do you clarify an ambiguous problem, size it with numbers, choose components for stated reasons, find the bottleneck and name the trade-off you accepted?", what does "ambiguous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡjuəs/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, nhiều nghĩa. "An ambiguous problem" = bài toán chưa rõ ràng, có thể hiểu theo nhiều cách.
items.explanationEn: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡjuəs/ (adjective): open to several meanings. "An ambiguous problem" can be understood in more than one way, so it needs clarifying.

items.question: Trong câu "In 45–60 minutes the interviewer watches how you reason: do you clarify an ambiguous problem, size it with numbers, choose components for stated reasons, find the bottleneck and name the trade-off you accepted?", từ "bottleneck" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In 45–60 minutes the interviewer watches how you reason: do you clarify an ambiguous problem, size it with numbers, choose components for stated reasons, find the bottleneck and name the trade-off you accepted?", what does "bottleneck" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bottleneck /ˈbɒtlnek/ (danh từ): điểm nghẽn. "Find the bottleneck" = tìm thành phần giới hạn hiệu năng của cả hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: bottleneck /ˈbɒtlnek/ (noun): a limiting point. "Find the bottleneck" means locating the component that limits the whole system.

items.question: Trong câu "In 45–60 minutes the interviewer watches how you reason: do you clarify an ambiguous problem, size it with numbers, choose components for stated reasons, find the bottleneck and name the trade-off you accepted?", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In 45–60 minutes the interviewer watches how you reason: do you clarify an ambiguous problem, size it with numbers, choose components for stated reasons, find the bottleneck and name the trade-off you accepted?", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "Name the trade-off" = nói rõ mình chấp nhận mất gì để được gì.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ (noun): a balance between two gains. "Name the trade-off" means stating what you gave up in exchange for what you gained.

items.question: Trong câu "If the interviewer steers, follow.", từ "steer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the interviewer steers, follow.", what does "steer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: steer /stɪə(r)/ (động từ): định hướng, dẫn dắt. "Steer the conversation" = dẫn dắt cuộc trò chuyện theo hướng mong muốn.
items.explanationEn: steer /stɪə(r)/ (verb): to guide in a direction. "Steer the conversation" means guiding it in a chosen direction.

items.question: Trong câu "Think out loud, write numbers on the board and check in", từ "think out loud" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Think out loud, write numbers on the board and check in", what does "think out loud" (phrase) mean?
options: nói to cho mọi người nghe
nói ra suy nghĩ khi nghĩ
optionsEn: to speak loudly to a crowd
to say your thoughts as you think
items.explanation: think out loud /θɪŋk aʊt laʊd/ (cụm từ): nói ra suy nghĩ khi nghĩ. Trong phỏng vấn, "think out loud" giúp người phỏng vấn theo được lập luận của bạn.
items.explanationEn: think out loud /θɪŋk aʊt laʊd/ (phrase): to say your thoughts as you think. In interviews, thinking out loud lets the interviewer follow your reasoning.

items.question: Trong câu "Every prompt ("design a chat app") is deliberately vague.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every prompt ("design a chat app") is deliberately vague.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪbərətli/ (trạng từ): một cách cố ý. "Deliberately vague" = cố tình mơ hồ, để xem ứng viên có hỏi lại không.
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪbərətli/ (adverb): on purpose. "Deliberately vague" means vague on purpose, to see whether the candidate asks questions.

items.question: Trong câu "Every prompt ("design a chat app") is deliberately vague.", từ "vague" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every prompt ("design a chat app") is deliberately vague.", what does "vague" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: vague /veɪɡ/ (tính từ): không rõ ràng. "A vague prompt" = đề bài chung chung, thiếu chi tiết.
items.explanationEn: vague /veɪɡ/ (adjective): not clearly stated. "A vague prompt" is general and lacks detail.

items.question: Trong câu "Non-functional — scale (DAU, read/write ratio), latency (p99 < 200 ms), availability (99.9 % vs 99.99 %), consistency (is a stale read acceptable?), durability, geography, compliance.", từ "stale" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Non-functional — scale (DAU, read/write ratio), latency (p99 < 200 ms), availability (99.9 % vs 99.99 %), consistency (is a stale read acceptable?), durability, geography, compliance.", what does "stale" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stale /steɪl/ (tính từ): cũ, lỗi thời (dữ liệu). "A stale read" = đọc phải dữ liệu chưa được cập nhật mới nhất.
items.explanationEn: stale /steɪl/ (adjective): out of date (data). "A stale read" returns data that is not the latest version.

items.question: Trong câu "Non-functional — scale (DAU, read/write ratio), latency (p99 < 200 ms), availability (99.9 % vs 99.99 %), consistency (is a stale read acceptable?), durability, geography, compliance.", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Non-functional — scale (DAU, read/write ratio), latency (p99 < 200 ms), availability (99.9 % vs 99.99 %), consistency (is a stale read acceptable?), durability, geography, compliance.", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪəns/ (danh từ): sự tuân thủ quy định. "Compliance" (vd. GDPR, PCI) là yêu cầu phi chức năng về tuân thủ luật và chuẩn.
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪəns/ (noun): following rules and laws. "Compliance" (e.g. GDPR, PCI) is a non-functional need to meet laws and standards.

items.question: Trong câu "Constraints — existing stack, team, budget, deadline.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Constraints — existing stack, team, budget, deadline.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc, giới hạn. "Constraints" = những giới hạn có sẵn như ngân sách, hạn chót, đội ngũ.
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limit or restriction. "Constraints" are existing limits such as budget, deadline and team.

items.question: Trong câu "A stated assumption is a strength; a silent one is a bug.", từ "assumption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A stated assumption is a strength; a silent one is a bug.", what does "assumption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assumption /əˈsʌmpʃn/ (danh từ): giả định. "State an assumption" = nói ra điều mình tạm coi là đúng khi chưa có thông tin.
items.explanationEn: assumption /əˈsʌmpʃn/ (noun): something taken as true. "State an assumption" means saying aloud what you take as true without confirmation.

items.question: Trong câu "Estimates answer one question: does this fit on one machine, or do I need to partition, cache or queue?", từ "partition" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Estimates answer one question: does this fit on one machine, or do I need to partition, cache or queue?", what does "partition" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: partition /pɑːˈtɪʃn/ (động từ): chia nhỏ (dữ liệu). "Partition the data" = chia dữ liệu ra nhiều máy/phân vùng.
items.explanationEn: partition /pɑːˈtɪʃn/ (verb): to split data into parts. "Partition the data" means splitting it across several machines or shards.

items.question: Trong câu "Round aggressively, but show the arithmetic.", từ "aggressively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Round aggressively, but show the arithmetic.", what does "aggressively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: aggressively /əˈɡresɪvli/ (trạng từ): mạnh tay, triệt để. "Round aggressively" = làm tròn số mạnh tay cho dễ tính nhẩm.
items.explanationEn: aggressively /əˈɡresɪvli/ (adverb): boldly and heavily. "Round aggressively" means rounding heavily so mental maths stays easy.

items.question: Trong câu "Round aggressively, but show the arithmetic.", từ "arithmetic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Round aggressively, but show the arithmetic.", what does "arithmetic" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: arithmetic /əˈrɪθmətɪk/ (danh từ): phép tính số học. "Show the arithmetic" = viết ra các phép tính để người khác kiểm tra.
items.explanationEn: arithmetic /əˈrɪθmətɪk/ (noun): calculations with numbers. "Show the arithmetic" means writing out the calculations so others can check them.

items.question: Trong câu "Then use it: 18 TB does not sit comfortably on one database node, so plan for partitioning.", từ "comfortably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Then use it: 18 TB does not sit comfortably on one database node, so plan for partitioning.", what does "comfortably" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: comfortably /ˈkʌmftəbli/ (trạng từ): dư dả, thoải mái. "Fit comfortably" = vừa một cách dư dả, không sát giới hạn.
items.explanationEn: comfortably /ˈkʌmftəbli/ (adverb): with room to spare. "Fit comfortably" means fitting with room to spare, not at the limit.

items.question: Trong câu "Define the contract before drawing boxes:", từ "contract" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Define the contract before drawing boxes:", what does "contract" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: contract /ˈkɒntrækt/ (danh từ): giao ước giao tiếp (API). Trong phần mềm, "API contract" = thỏa thuận về đầu vào/đầu ra giữa client và server.
items.explanationEn: contract /ˈkɒntrækt/ (noun): an agreed interface. In software, an "API contract" is the agreed input and output between client and server.

items.question: Trong câu "One sentence each on the cross-cutting parts: auth at the gateway (OAuth 2.0 / JWT), idempotency keys on creates, cursor pagination for data that changes while paging, rate limits per API key.", từ "cross-cutting" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One sentence each on the cross-cutting parts: auth at the gateway (OAuth 2.0 / JWT), idempotency keys on creates, cursor pagination for data that changes while paging, rate limits per API key.", what does "cross-cutting" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: cross-cutting /ˈkrɒs kʌtɪŋ/ (tính từ): áp dụng xuyên suốt. "Cross-cutting concerns" = vấn đề chung ảnh hưởng mọi endpoint, như auth, rate limit.
items.explanationEn: cross-cutting /ˈkrɒs kʌtɪŋ/ (adjective): affecting many parts. "Cross-cutting concerns" affect every endpoint, such as auth and rate limits.

items.question: Trong câu "Pick the store from access patterns, not entities:", từ "entity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pick the store from access patterns, not entities:", what does "entity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: entity /ˈentəti/ (danh từ): thực thể (dữ liệu). "Entities" = các đối tượng dữ liệu như User, Post, Message.
items.explanationEn: entity /ˈentəti/ (noun): a data object type. "Entities" are data objects such as User, Post and Message.

items.question: Trong câu "Draw the simplest design that meets the requirements, then evolve it:", từ "evolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Draw the simplest design that meets the requirements, then evolve it:", what does "evolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: evolve /iˈvɒlv/ (động từ): phát triển dần. "Evolve the design" = cải tiến thiết kế từng bước khi tải tăng.
items.explanationEn: evolve /iˈvɒlv/ (verb): to develop step by step. "Evolve the design" means improving it step by step as load grows.

items.question: Trong câu "Hot key / celebrity → cache with jitter, key splitting, a special-case path.", từ "jitter" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hot key / celebrity → cache with jitter, key splitting, a special-case path.", what does "jitter" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: jitter /ˈdʒɪtə(r)/ (danh từ): độ lệch ngẫu nhiên nhỏ. "TTL with jitter" = thêm chút ngẫu nhiên để các khóa không hết hạn cùng lúc.
items.explanationEn: jitter /ˈdʒɪtə(r)/ (noun): small random variation. "TTL with jitter" adds randomness so keys do not all expire at once.

items.question: Trong câu "Synchronous call chains → timeouts, circuit breakers, non-critical work behind a queue.", từ "synchronous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Synchronous call chains → timeouts, circuit breakers, non-critical work behind a queue.", what does "synchronous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: synchronous /ˈsɪŋkrənəs/ (tính từ): đồng bộ (chờ kết quả). "Synchronous call" = bên gọi phải chờ bên kia trả lời mới chạy tiếp.
items.explanationEn: synchronous /ˈsɪŋkrənəs/ (adjective): waiting for each result. In a "synchronous call" the caller waits for the reply before continuing.

items.question: Trong câu "One AZ → multi-AZ; multi-region only if requirements demand it (it costs consistency and money).", từ "demand" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One AZ → multi-AZ; multi-region only if requirements demand it (it costs consistency and money).", what does "demand" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: demand /dɪˈmɑːnd/ (động từ): đòi hỏi, cần đến. "If requirements demand it" = chỉ khi yêu cầu thực sự cần tới.
items.explanationEn: demand /dɪˈmɑːnd/ (verb): to require. "If requirements demand it" means only when the requirements really need it.

items.question: Trong câu "Single DB primary → read replicas, then sharding by a key that spreads load.", từ "spread" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Single DB primary → read replicas, then sharding by a key that spreads load.", what does "spread" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: spread /spred/ (động từ): phân tán, dàn đều. "Spread load" = rải tải đều ra nhiều máy, tránh dồn vào một shard.
items.explanationEn: spread /spred/ (verb): to distribute evenly. "Spread load" means distributing traffic evenly so no single shard is overloaded.

items.question: Trong câu "Non-functional: redirect p99 < 50 ms, very high read availability, a code must never point to the wrong URL, codes not trivially guessable.", từ "trivially" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Non-functional: redirect p99 < 50 ms, very high read availability, a code must never point to the wrong URL, codes not trivially guessable.", what does "trivially" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: trivially /ˈtrɪviəli/ (trạng từ): một cách dễ dàng. "Not trivially guessable" = không thể đoán ra một cách dễ dàng.
items.explanationEn: trivially /ˈtrɪviəli/ (adverb): very easily. "Not trivially guessable" means it cannot be guessed easily.

items.question: Trong câu "Functional: create a short link (optional alias, expiry), redirect, click counts.", từ "expiry" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Functional: create a short link (optional alias, expiry), redirect, click counts.", what does "expiry" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: expiry /ɪkˈspaɪəri/ (danh từ): sự hết hạn. "Expiry" = thời điểm link hết hiệu lực; hay đi với "expiry date".
items.explanationEn: expiry /ɪkˈspaɪəri/ (noun): the end of validity. "Expiry" is when a link stops being valid; often seen in "expiry date".

items.question: Trong câu "Assumptions: 100 M new links/day, read:write = 10:1, 10-year retention, ~500 bytes per record.", từ "retention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Assumptions: 100 M new links/day, read:write = 10:1, 10-year retention, ~500 bytes per record.", what does "retention" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: retention /rɪˈtenʃn/ (danh từ): thời gian lưu giữ. "10-year retention" = dữ liệu được giữ lại trong 10 năm.
items.explanationEn: retention /rɪˈtenʃn/ (noun): how long data is kept. "10-year retention" means the data is kept for ten years.

items.question: Trong câu "A solid answer: each link-service instance leases a block of 1 M IDs from a small coordination store (a DB row updated in a transaction, or etcd), applies a reversible scramble, then encodes base62:", từ "solid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A solid answer: each link-service instance leases a block of 1 M IDs from a small coordination store (a DB row updated in a transaction, or etcd), applies a reversible scramble, then encodes base62:", what does "solid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: solid /ˈsɒlɪd/ (tính từ): vững chắc, đáng tin. "A solid answer" = câu trả lời chắc chắn, có cơ sở.
items.explanationEn: solid /ˈsɒlɪd/ (adjective): reliable and sound. "A solid answer" is sound and well reasoned.

items.question: Trong câu "A solid answer: each link-service instance leases a block of 1 M IDs from a small coordination store (a DB row updated in a transaction, or etcd), applies a reversible scramble, then encodes base62:", từ "lease" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A solid answer: each link-service instance leases a block of 1 M IDs from a small coordination store (a DB row updated in a transaction, or etcd), applies a reversible scramble, then encodes base62:", what does "lease" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to hold for a limited time
items.explanation: lease /liːs/ (động từ): thuê/giữ tạm có thời hạn. "Lease a block of IDs" = giữ quyền dùng một dải ID trong một khoảng thời gian.
items.explanationEn: lease /liːs/ (verb): to hold for a limited time. "Lease a block of IDs" means holding the right to use a range for a period.

items.question: Trong câu "A solid answer: each link-service instance leases a block of 1 M IDs from a small coordination store (a DB row updated in a transaction, or etcd), applies a reversible scramble, then encodes base62:", từ "coordination" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A solid answer: each link-service instance leases a block of 1 M IDs from a small coordination store (a DB row updated in a transaction, or etcd), applies a reversible scramble, then encodes base62:", what does "coordination" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: coordination /kəʊˌɔːdɪˈneɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự điều phối. "Coordination store" = kho nhỏ giúp các máy phối hợp, tránh cấp trùng ID.
items.explanationEn: coordination /kəʊˌɔːdɪˈneɪʃn/ (noun): organising parts to work together. A "coordination store" helps servers work together so IDs are not handed out twice.

items.question: Trong câu "A solid answer: each link-service instance leases a block of 1 M IDs from a small coordination store (a DB row updated in a transaction, or etcd), applies a reversible scramble, then encodes base62:", từ "reversible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A solid answer: each link-service instance leases a block of 1 M IDs from a small coordination store (a DB row updated in a transaction, or etcd), applies a reversible scramble, then encodes base62:", what does "reversible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reversible /rɪˈvɜːsəbl/ (tính từ): đảo ngược được. "A reversible scramble" = phép xáo trộn có thể giải ngược lại giá trị gốc.
items.explanationEn: reversible /rɪˈvɜːsəbl/ (adjective): able to be undone. A "reversible scramble" can be undone to recover the original value.

items.question: Trong câu "A solid answer: each link-service instance leases a block of 1 M IDs from a small coordination store (a DB row updated in a transaction, or etcd), applies a reversible scramble, then encodes base62:", từ "scramble" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A solid answer: each link-service instance leases a block of 1 M IDs from a small coordination store (a DB row updated in a transaction, or etcd), applies a reversible scramble, then encodes base62:", what does "scramble" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scramble /ˈskræmbl/ (danh từ): phép xáo trộn. Ở đây "scramble" = phép biến đổi xáo trộn thứ tự để mã không lộ tuần tự.
items.explanationEn: scramble /ˈskræmbl/ (noun): a mixing-up transformation. Here "scramble" is a transformation that hides the sequential order of codes.

items.question: Trong câu "Redirect status: 301 lets browsers cache the redirect (less load, but repeat clicks vanish from analytics and the target is hard to change); 302 sends every click through you — the usual choice when analytics matters.", từ "vanish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Redirect status: 301 lets browsers cache the redirect (less load, but repeat clicks vanish from analytics and the target is hard to change); 302 sends every click through you — the usual choice when analytics matters.", what does "vanish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: vanish /ˈvænɪʃ/ (động từ): biến mất. "Vanish from analytics" = không còn xuất hiện trong số liệu thống kê.
items.explanationEn: vanish /ˈvænɪʃ/ (verb): to disappear. "Vanish from analytics" means no longer showing up in the statistics.

items.question: Trong câu "Also say: store code → {longUrl, ownerId, expiresAt} in a KV store partitioned by code (scrambled codes spread evenly, no hot shards); cache-aside with TTL; click events go async so analytics can never slow a redirect; custom aliases use a conditional "insert if not exists" to avoid races.", từ "evenly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.question: Trong câu "Standard answer: hybrid — push for normal accounts (skipping inactive followers), pull for accounts above a follower threshold, merge both at read time, then rank.", từ "rank" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Standard answer: hybrid — push for normal accounts (skipping inactive followers), pull for accounts above a follower threshold, merge both at read time, then rank.", what does "rank" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: rank /ræŋk/ (động từ): xếp hạng. "Then rank" = sắp xếp bài theo mức độ liên quan.
items.explanationEn: rank /ræŋk/ (verb): to order by importance. "Then rank" means ordering posts by relevance.

items.question: Trong câu "Deleted posts are filtered at hydration rather than removed from millions of feeds.", từ "rather than" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deleted posts are filtered at hydration rather than removed from millions of feeds.", what does "rather than" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rather than /ˈrɑːðə ðæn/ (cụm từ): thay vì. "A rather than B" = chọn A thay vì B.
items.explanationEn: rather than /ˈrɑːðə ðæn/ (phrase): instead of. "A rather than B" means choosing A instead of B.

items.question: Trong câu "Numbers without consequences — computing 23,000 QPS and never saying what it implies.", từ "imply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Numbers without consequences — computing 23,000 QPS and never saying what it implies.", what does "imply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: imply /ɪmˈplaɪ/ (động từ): ngụ ý, kéo theo. "What it implies" = con số đó dẫn đến điều gì cho thiết kế.
items.explanationEn: imply /ɪmˈplaɪ/ (verb): to suggest as a result. "What it implies" means what that number means for the design.

items.question: Trong câu "Match the design to the estimates and say which threshold would trigger the next step.", từ "trigger" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Match the design to the estimates and say which threshold would trigger the next step.", what does "trigger" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trigger /ˈtrɪɡə(r)/ (động từ): kích hoạt. "Trigger the next step" = làm bước tiếp theo bắt đầu.
items.explanationEn: trigger /ˈtrɪɡə(r)/ (verb): to set off. "Trigger the next step" means causing the next step to start.

items.question: Trong câu "Buzzwords — "add Redis" without the key, TTL and invalidation.", từ "buzzword" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Buzzwords — "add Redis" without the key, TTL and invalidation.", what does "buzzword" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: buzzword /ˈbʌzwɜːd/ (danh từ): từ thời thượng sáo rỗng. "Buzzwords" = từ nghe hay nhưng nói ra mà không có chi tiết thực.
items.explanationEn: buzzword /ˈbʌzwɜːd/ (noun): a trendy empty term. "Buzzwords" sound impressive but are used without real detail.

items.question: Trong câu "Buzzwords — "add Redis" without the key, TTL and invalidation.", từ "invalidation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Buzzwords — "add Redis" without the key, TTL and invalidation.", what does "invalidation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: invalidation /ɪnˌvælɪˈdeɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự vô hiệu hóa (cache). "Cache invalidation" = xóa hoặc đánh dấu cache cũ khi dữ liệu gốc đổi.
items.explanationEn: invalidation /ɪnˌvælɪˈdeɪʃn/ (noun): marking cached data outdated. "Cache invalidation" removes or marks stale entries when source data changes.

items.question: Trong câu "Monologue or silence, and trying to cover everything instead of going deep on two parts.", từ "monologue" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Monologue or silence, and trying to cover everything instead of going deep on two parts.", what does "monologue" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: monologue /ˈmɒnəlɒɡ/ (danh từ): độc thoại. "Monologue" = nói một mình liên tục, không tương tác với người phỏng vấn.
items.explanationEn: monologue /ˈmɒnəlɒɡ/ (noun): one person talking alone. A "monologue" is talking on and on without engaging the interviewer.

items.question: Trong câu "Monologue or silence, and trying to cover everything instead of going deep on two parts.", từ "cover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Monologue or silence, and trying to cover everything instead of going deep on two parts.", what does "cover" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cover /ˈkʌvə(r)/ (động từ): bao quát, đề cập. "Cover everything" = cố đề cập đến mọi thứ.
items.explanationEn: cover /ˈkʌvə(r)/ (verb): to deal with a topic. "Cover everything" means trying to deal with every topic.

items.question: Trong câu "Clarify scope; when unanswered, state assumptions aloud and write them down.", từ "aloud" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clarify scope; when unanswered, state assumptions aloud and write them down.", what does "aloud" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: aloud /əˈlaʊd/ (trạng từ): thành tiếng. "State assumptions aloud" = nói to giả định cho người phỏng vấn nghe.
items.explanationEn: aloud /əˈlaʊd/ (adverb): out loud. "State assumptions aloud" means saying them so the interviewer hears.

items.question: Trong câu "The interview grades structured reasoning, not a memorised diagram.", từ "grade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The interview grades structured reasoning, not a memorised diagram.", what does "grade" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: grade /ɡreɪd/ (động từ): chấm điểm, đánh giá. "Grade" ở đây = chấm điểm, đánh giá ứng viên.
items.explanationEn: grade /ɡreɪd/ (verb): to mark or assess. Here "grade" means to assess and mark the candidate.

items.question: Trong câu "The interview grades structured reasoning, not a memorised diagram.", từ "memorise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The interview grades structured reasoning, not a memorised diagram.", what does "memorise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: memorise /ˈmeməraɪz/ (động từ): học thuộc lòng. "A memorised diagram" = sơ đồ học thuộc sẵn, không tự suy luận.
items.explanationEn: memorise /ˈmeməraɪz/ (verb): to learn by heart. A "memorised diagram" is learned by heart rather than reasoned out.

items.question: Trong câu "Deep dives target what is genuinely hard: ID generation, distributed counting, stateful connections, fan-out.", từ "genuinely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deep dives target what is genuinely hard: ID generation, distributed counting, stateful connections, fan-out.", what does "genuinely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: genuinely /ˈdʒenjuɪnli/ (trạng từ): thực sự. "Genuinely hard" = khó thật sự, không phải chỉ trông có vẻ khó.
items.explanationEn: genuinely /ˈdʒenjuɪnli/ (adverb): truly. "Genuinely hard" means truly difficult, not just seemingly so.

items.question: Trong câu "Name the trade-off of every decision and the failure mode of every component.", từ "failure mode" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Name the trade-off of every decision and the failure mode of every component.", what does "failure mode" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: failure mode /ˈfeɪljə məʊd/ (cụm từ): cách thức hỏng hóc. "Failure mode" = kiểu hỏng có thể xảy ra và hậu quả của nó.
items.explanationEn: failure mode /ˈfeɪljə məʊd/ (phrase): the way something breaks. A "failure mode" is a way a component can break and what follows.
